scope: All 5183 documents and all 300 previously evaluated queries; known benchmark development after prior feedback, not independent testing.
text: Reuse E1 title + abstract chunk/query policy and pinned ColBERT checkpoint: 160 WordPiece chunks, stride128, no chunk limit, 64 query slots; full source token coverage. BM25 and dense retain original input policy.
index: Re-encode all documents on CPU, including previously cached documents, for a measured full-corpus build. Float32 padded chunk vectors and masks, exact MaxSim and max-chunk document pooling. No ANN, compression, PLAID or trained index. Record actual serialized bytes and tensor bytes separately.
candidates: BM25 and dense each return100; original equal-weight RRF60 returns100. ColBERT50 reranks50 and preserves ranks51-100, ColBERT100 reranks100, full scores every document. Preserve deterministic document-ID ties; no qrels enter scoring.
timing: One warm serial pass per method over all300 queries. Each pipeline independently executes its query tokenization/encoding, candidate retrieval, scoring and sorting from scratch against loaded indexes. Measure wall-clock total and nested components per query; compute p50/p95 of actual totals, not sum of percentiles. No result cache, no network, no API overhead, no concurrency or SLA claim. Alternate forward/reverse method order by query index to reduce systematic order bias.
preparation: Measure model loading, warmup, BM25 build, dense full-corpus encoding, ColBERT chunking/full encoding/serialization separately. Index bytes exclude model weights and source text; report those separately. Process peak RSS includes preparation and all resident models, not per-method memory.
evaluation: Freeze all rankings and timing rows before attaching already-known relevance labels from parent. Report every method, all300 queries, paired gains/losses, candidate-outside found/lost targets; unjudged documents are not confirmed negatives. No outcome-driven selection or default replacement.
uncertainty: Paired query bootstrap of NDCG@10 differences, 2000 repetitions, seed20261016; descriptive range on known data, no multiple-comparison adjustment or new-domain guarantee.
limits: public pretrained checkpoints may overlap benchmark
no measured human search time or financial ROI
